article.title: WebMD Ignite推出ChatGPT廣告服務，醫療機構仍須通過平台審核
article.title_en: WebMD Ignite introduces ChatGPT ads service subject to platform eligibility and review
article.summary: WebMD Ignite宣布向合資格醫療機構提供ChatGPT廣告策劃、創意、啟動及衡量服務。
article.summary_en: WebMD Ignite announced ChatGPT advertising strategy, creative, activation and measurement services for eligible health systems.
highlights: WebMD Ignite負責策略及執行，OpenAI決定資格、素材批准及投放。
公司提及初期心臟科活動，未披露機構名稱或成效數據。
highlights_en: WebMD Ignite handles strategy and execution; OpenAI controls eligibility, creative approval and delivery.
An initial cardiology campaign is mentioned without naming the institution or reporting outcomes.
article.why: 醫療廣告多了一個服務渠道，團隊須先把服務線目標對應平台資格與審核要求，才決定是否分配測試預算。
article.why_en: A new service channel requires health marketers to match service-line objectives with platform eligibility and review before budgeting a test.
article.next_step: 選一條服務線，先取得廣告主與素材資格要求，列清WebMD Ignite及平台各自負責的批准環節，再制定衡量方案。
article.next_step_en: Select one service line, obtain advertiser and creative requirements, map provider and platform approvals, then specify measurement.
article.detail: 消息來自WebMD Ignite公司新聞稿。初期案例描述素材變體、對話情境及地域相關性的測試安排，沒有可核對的銷售或病人增長結果。編輯建議把准入條件、素材版本及評估指標分別記錄，避免把代辦服務視為保證投放成功。這次公告不能據此推定所有醫療機構均可使用，也不構成對廣告合規或私隱安排的獨立認證。
article.detail_en: The issuer release describes creative variations, conversational contexts and geographic relevance in an initial effort, with no verified growth results. Record access conditions, creative versions and assessment metrics separately. A managed service does not guarantee delivery, universal health-system access, legal compliance or independently certified privacy protections.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
